title: Flight Time Calculator
description: Turn departure time + flight duration + time-zone offsets into the correct local arrival time, with the UTC timeline shown step by step.
howto: Enter departure date/time (local time at the origin).
Enter the flight duration in hours and minutes.
Enter the UTC offsets of the origin and destination (e.g. +5, −4).
Press Calculate for the local arrival time plus the full UTC timeline.

faqs.q: How is the arrival time actually computed?
faqs.a: Departure local → UTC (subtract origin offset) → add duration → destination local (add destination offset). The tool shows each conversion so you can verify it.

faqs.q: Where do I find the UTC offsets?
faqs.a: Airline itineraries often show them; otherwise search 'UTC offset' for each city. Remember daylight saving can shift a city's offset by an hour.
It is handled automatically: crossing the date line just means the UTC math lands on a different calendar day, which the result shows explicitly.
